pages.title: Circadian Incubator
pages.text: An incubator with a lamp on the day cycle, so its cultures keep the time the world keeps.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the period and the phase of the light. The culture runs fastest when its active phase meets the world's day; a quarter of the recipe's rate at night. (It also reads the real daylight where it stands.)
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Circadian Culture, Cryptochrome Magnetoreceptor.
